skill_name: Describe how the Stock Market works.
workflow: The stock market is a financial market where investors can buy and sell shares of public companies. Investors buy and sell shares of stock, which are units of ownership in a publicly-traded company. When stock prices rise, investors profit, and when stock prices fall, investors can face losses. The prices of a stock are determined by supply and demand in the stock market, which is determined by the buyers and sellers. Companies can also issue and sell additional shares, called secondary stocks,
